title.zh-TW: 東亞區域領袖峰會聚焦貿易與安全合作
title.en: East Asia summit focuses on trade and security cooperation

summary.zh-TW: 多國領袖於峰會討論供應鏈韌性與海上安全。各方同意成立工作小組，但具體時程與約束力仍待後續談判。
summary.en: Leaders discussed supply-chain resilience and maritime security. They agreed to form working groups, though timelines and binding commitments remain to be negotiated.

disagreements.zh-TW: 部分媒體強調安全對抗意味，另一些則凸顯經貿進展；對「實質成果」評估分歧。
disagreements.en: Some outlets stress security rivalry; others highlight economic progress. Assessments of 'substance' diverge.

title.zh-TW: 聯合國氣候融資談判延長至深夜仍無共識
title.en: UN climate finance talks run late without consensus

summary.zh-TW: 開發中國家要求提高損失與損害基金規模，已開發國家主張先完善監督機制。會期延長但未達成最終文本。
summary.en: Developing nations seek a larger loss-and-damage fund; developed countries want stronger oversight first. Talks extended without a final text.

disagreements.zh-TW: 對「誰應多出資」的歸因不同；報導對談判僵局責任歸屬不一致。
disagreements.en: Attribution of who should pay more differs; blame for the deadlock is framed inconsistently.

title.zh-TW: 主要央行暗示利率路徑分歧，股市波動升高
title.en: Major central banks signal divergent rate paths; markets wobble

summary.zh-TW: 美國與歐洲官員對通膨黏著度看法不一，導致利率預期分化。債券殖利率與科技股同日出現較大幅度擺盪。
summary.en: US and European officials differ on how sticky inflation remains, splitting rate expectations. Bond yields and tech shares swung sharply the same day.

disagreements.zh-TW: 部分分析認為波動屬正常重新定價；另有評論警告流動性緊縮風險被低估。
disagreements.en: Some call the moves a normal re-pricing; others warn liquidity-tightening risks are understated.

title.zh-TW: 亞洲新創募資回溫，但估值仍低於 2021 高峰
title.en: Asia startup fundraising rebounds, valuations still below 2021 peak

summary.zh-TW: 種子與 A 輪交易量季增，後期輪次仍偏謹慎。投資人更重視單位經濟與路徑至獲利。
summary.en: Seed and Series A deal volume rose quarter-over-quarter; later rounds stay cautious. Investors emphasize unit economics and paths to profitability.

title.zh-TW: 新一代折疊手機量產良率提升，供應鏈股受關注
title.en: Foldable phone yields improve; supply-chain stocks in focus

summary.zh-TW: 多家組裝與面板供應商報告良率改善，分析師上調部分出貨預估。消費者接受度與長期耐用性仍是觀察重點。
summary.en: Assemblers and panel makers report better yields; analysts raised some shipment estimates. Consumer uptake and long-term durability remain open questions.

disagreements.zh-TW: 消費媒體偏樂觀於設計；產業媒體對良率數字來源與可比性較謹慎。
disagreements.en: Consumer press is more upbeat on design; trade press is cautious about yield figures and comparability.

title.zh-TW: 大型雲端商擴大資料中心投資，電力與冷卻成瓶頸
title.en: Hyperscalers expand data centers; power and cooling become bottlenecks

summary.zh-TW: 資本支出指引上修，但多地電網與用水限制延遲部分專案。企業改採更高效散熱與再生能源合約。
summary.en: Capex guidance rose, yet grid and water limits delayed some sites. Firms push denser cooling and renewable PPAs.

title.zh-TW: 開源模型新版本在多語基準接近專有系統
title.en: New open-weight model nears proprietary systems on multilingual benchmarks

summary.zh-TW: 社群釋出的模型在翻譯與推理基準上縮小落差，但仍落後於最頂尖專有模型的工具使用與長上下文表現。授權條款允許研究與多數商用。
summary.en: A community release narrowed gaps on translation and reasoning benches, while still trailing top proprietary systems on tool use and long context. License permits research and most commercial use.

disagreements.zh-TW: 支持者強調開源追趕速度；懷疑者指出基準可能過擬合、真實工作負載差距仍大。
disagreements.en: Boosters stress catch-up speed; skeptics note possible eval overfitting and larger real-workload gaps.

title.zh-TW: 多國提出 AI 標籤規範草案，產業呼吁統一標準
title.en: Countries float AI labeling drafts; industry seeks interoperable standards

summary.zh-TW: 草案要求對合成媒體與自動化決策揭露。科技公會警告碎片化合規成本，公民團體則要求更嚴格罰則。
summary.en: Drafts would require disclosure for synthetic media and automated decisions. Trade groups warn of fragmented compliance costs; civic groups want stronger penalties.

disagreements.zh-TW: 對「標籤是否足夠」看法分裂：一方認為透明即可，另一方要求事前審核。
disagreements.en: Split on whether labels suffice: some say transparency is enough; others demand pre-clearance.

title.zh-TW: 人道援助走廊暫時重開，運量仍遠低於需求
title.en: Aid corridor briefly reopens; volumes far below need

summary.zh-TW: 國際組織證實有限車隊通過檢查站，但燃料與安全條件不穩。各方對可持續性說法不一。
summary.en: Agencies confirmed limited convoys through checkpoints, but fuel and security remain fragile. Parties disagree on how sustainable access will be.

disagreements.zh-TW: 對通行「是否構成實質改善」解讀不同；數字口徑（計畫量 vs 實際到達）不一致。
disagreements.en: Views differ on whether access is a material improvement; planned vs delivered volumes are reported inconsistently.

title.zh-TW: 零售通膨數據溫和，市場提高年內降息機率
title.en: Milder retail inflation print lifts odds of cuts this year

summary.zh-TW: 核心服務通膨略降，能源價格回落。期貨市場上調降息機率，但官員重申「數據依賴」。
summary.en: Core services eased slightly and energy prices fell. Futures raised cut odds, while officials reiterated a data-dependent stance.

title.zh-TW: 【成人／NSFW】成人產業工會推動表演者健康保險試點
title.en: [Adult/NSFW] Adult-industry union pushes performer health-insurance pilot

summary.zh-TW: （明確成人主題樣本）工會與平台討論為登記表演者提供基本健保試點，涵蓋定期檢查與心理健康資源。內容僅供選擇開啟成人區後瀏覽。
summary.en: (Clearly labeled adult-topic sample) A union and platforms discuss a basic health-insurance pilot for registered performers, covering checkups and mental-health resources. Shown only after adult-zone opt-in.

disagreements.zh-TW: 支持者視其為職業安全進步；批評者質疑資金永續與監管範圍。
disagreements.en: Supporters call it an occupational-safety step; critics question funding durability and regulatory scope.

title.zh-TW: 【成人／NSFW】法院就成人內容年齡驗證法提出部分合憲見解
title.en: [Adult/NSFW] Court issues partial ruling on adult-content age-verification law

summary.zh-TW: （明確成人主題樣本）法院認可保護未成年人之目標，但要求政府證明較少侵害隱私的替代方案不足。本案仍可能上訴。
summary.en: (Clearly labeled adult-topic sample) The court accepted the goal of protecting minors but required the state to show less privacy-invasive alternatives are insufficient. Appeal remains possible.

disagreements.zh-TW: 隱私倡議者與兒少保護團體對「合理驗證強度」標準嚴重分歧。
disagreements.en: Privacy advocates and child-protection groups sharply disagree on what verification intensity is reasonable.

title.zh-TW: 【成人／NSFW】主流支付商調整成人內容商戶風險分級政策
title.en: [Adult/NSFW] Major payment firms tweak adult-merchant risk tiers

summary.zh-TW: （明確成人主題樣本）部分支付通路提高合規文件要求並調整手續費；獨立創作者擔憂現金流中斷。政策文件為公開摘要等級。
summary.en: (Clearly labeled adult-topic sample) Some payment rails raised compliance paperwork and fees; independent creators worry about cash-flow gaps. Based on public policy summaries only.
